plots.brief: The Great Library: ~30x20 walls on this 34x22 plot, three storeys on a cut-stone plinth with a copper dome over the central stair hall and a long reading hall along the south side with tall mullioned windows. Pale stone, deepslate roof, an arcade along the front, deep blue banners, spruce doors. Faces the west avenue with broad steps up from the street.

Observatory crowning the hill: a round pale-stone tower ~9 wide and 5 storeys with an oxidised copper dome and an opening slit, on a terraced plinth with a low wall around a star-gazing terrace. A stair path climbs from the avenue door. Plainer than the library; a copper armillary sphere on the terrace is the special detail.

Masters' house of two storeys, ~10x8, on the shoulder of the hill beside the library: pale stone, steep deepslate roof, bay window, spruce door and shutters, a chimney and a small walled kitchen garden behind.

Printing house, 2 storeys ~12x9: wide ground-floor shopfront windows in spruce frames, a loft with a hoist beam over the door, paper drying racks under the eaves, stone bricks on a plinth, deepslate roof.
Hostel for visiting students, two storeys ~10x8, at the river end of the quarter: pale stone, dark oak shutters, small dormers, a lantern-hung porch with a bench.
School house ~14x10, one tall hall storey with a bell turret: plain pale stone, big mullioned windows, deepslate roof, a walled yard with a well. Door on the ring-road side.
Apothecary, two storeys ~11x8: stone-brick base, pale plaster upper floor, a hanging sign and jar-filled window boxes, a fenced herb plot at the side with a cauldron, copper gutters.
Masters' house ~12x9 with a south-facing walled garden toward the river; two storeys, pale stone and spruce, gabled roof, a study bay window capped in copper.

Garden square between library and college: paved in stone bricks and polished andesite in quarters around a central round fountain, clipped hedges, benches, lanterns on posts, trees at the corners. Pedestrian square reached from the library steps and the college; no street door.

The College around a cloistered courtyard: ~34x22 walls on this plot. Two-storey pale-stone ranges on all four sides with an arcaded cloister walk, a garden and well in the court, a gatehouse tower on the south street side with a copper cap, dark oak doors, deep blue banners. Plainer than the library.
Riverside masters' house ~9x8, two storeys, pale stone with a spruce porch and a terrace garden stepping down toward the river view.
Masters' house ~9x8, one and a half storeys, with a bay window and a copper-roofed oriel, hedge-walled garden behind facing the river.

Small open reading pavilion on the river bank at the quarter's south-east corner: stone colonnade, copper roof, steps down to the water and a bench terrace looking out where the river leaves the city.
Physic garden walled in stone bricks, ~15x18: herb beds in quartered pattern, a copper gate arch, a sundial and a gardener's shed. Entered from the garden square.
Bookbinder's workshop, one storey with a loft ~11x9, facing the garden square: stone and spruce, skylight in the roof, a stack of leather and paper under a lean-to.
